column1: # lls differential suite — the ENUMERATED NAME/SHIM table (CLAUDE.md §3.5).
# One row per NAME the reference hand port spells differently from the emitted port. Applied by
# `scripts/shim-apply.pl` to COMMENT-MASKED code only, per receiver expression; a row that fires
# nowhere is reported by the lane, because it is a claim about the two APIs that stopped being true.
# Kinds: `type` (whole-word identifier), `member` (a `.selection`), `text` (a literal call shape).
# What is NOT here, on purpose: nothing that would make a failing assertion pass. A test whose
# assertion cannot survive the port's shape is listed in `diff-incompatible.tsv` with its reason.
# kind
# (1) `Select` is a java SINGLETON reached through `instance()`; lls promoted the five-argument
# member to the companion. The port emits java's shape, so the call moves to the instance.
text
text
# …and lls threads an `MkArray` witness the port has no analogue for (its arrays are java's). The
# argument is dropped, per call shape, by its exact spelling — never by position, and one row per
# shape the suite actually writes (17 + 1 + 2 sites) rather than one pattern over an argument list.
text
text
text
# (2) NULLARY ARITY. lls drops `()` from java's getter-like nullary methods; that is the L1
# `NullaryArityTransform` rung, which this port does not run, so the emitted members keep java's
# arity. Per RECEIVER (`set.`), never as a bare member rename: `Nullable.isEmpty` is genuinely
# paren-less and a member-wide row would break it.
